story.title: NHS orders AI-related close-sourcing of hundreds of GitHub repositories over Anthropic security concerns
story.summary: The UK's National Health Service has issued a directive requiring technology leaders to wall off hundreds of its open-source GitHub repositories, citing concerns about advanced AI capabilities and specifically referencing Anthropic's Mythos. All maintainers have been given a May deadline to enact the change. The move marks one of the largest government-mandated AI-driven open-source restrictions by a public health body anywhere in the world.
